title: Platine Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Platine Wars", at revision 1381272611, opens: "The Platine Wars is a term used by Brazilian historiography to refer to a series of diplomatic and military conflicts along the 19th century between the Empire of Brazil and neighbouring countries in the Río de la Plata Basin." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q10356223, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "time period in Brazilian historiography". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
